name: lw_4050
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a + 2 * b = 1) : 1 / a + 1 / Real.sqrt (a * b) ≥ 9 / 2
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a + 2 * b = 1), 1 / a + 1 / Real.sqrt (a * b) ≥ 9 / 2
informal: Let $a,b,c$ be positive reals such that $a+2b=1.$ Prove that \n $$\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{ \sqrt{ab}}\geq \frac {9}{2}$$
